rule_hit_review.why: "After 2 weeks of usage" is the dosing schedule from F13 (alternate days first, then daily), not a result promised within 2 weeks.

tone_read: Calm evening-routine guidance with a named supplier grade; no fear, hype or result language.
language_read: "2% Salicylic Acid" is in house format, and naming "RonaCare Salicylic Acid Extra Pure from Merck, Germany" follows the brand's precise-grade practice (F8) rather than a vague "100% pure". The dosing, skin-type and age lines are verbatim from the page.
